name: Allied Plastics LLC
old_description: Innovative Vacuum Thermoforming Services for Durable Plastic Solutions
about:
Allied Plastics LLC operates from Twin Lakes, Wisconsin. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year or ownership structure, and no founders are named in available sources.

The company specializes in heavy-gauge vacuum thermoforming and custom sheet extrusion, producing plastic components up to 8 feet by 14 feet by 60 inches thick using material from 0.060 to 0.55 inches. Its capabilities include single-sheet, twin-sheet, drape, pressure, and sheet-over-sheet forming, along with CNC and robotic trimming, die cutting, punching, finishing, hardware installation, bonding, assembly, kitting, inventory management, just-in-time stocking, packaging, labeling, and fulfillment. Allied Plastics runs more than 20 thermoforming machines across a 210,000-square-foot manufacturing facility and a 350,000-square-foot distribution and manufacturing facility.

The company serves agriculture, automotive, medical, construction, lawn and garden, transportation, and industrial markets, as well as packaging and dunnage applications. Customers include OEMs and manufacturers seeking durable parts, reusable packaging, material handling solutions, and custom thermoformed assemblies such as weather-resistant housings, automotive interior and exterior components, medical trays and housings, and industrial enclosures and guards.

Allied Plastics emphasizes an integrated model that combines plastics engineering, manufacturing, finishing, inventory support, and delivery under one roof to reduce handoffs and improve control over quality and lead times. The company cites its senior team’s 30-plus years of thermoforming experience and its in-house extrusion capability as key differentiators for consistent material performance and streamlined production.
